paper.note: Pure off-white, zero chroma. Never cream/tinted.

ink-muted.note: Near AA floor; large/non-essential text only.

label.purpose: Metadata, captions, secondary UI. tabular-nums on numbers.

shadows.name: primary-lift
shadows.purpose: Primary button at rest: colored glow tinted to the blue. The only resting shadow on the page.

shadows.name: inset-highlight
shadows.purpose: Dark-mode top edge on translucent surfaces (secondary button, founder letter).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions and the hero reveal.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Active-state press feedback on buttons; 0.97-0.98 on large cards/pills, never below 0.95.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: State transitions. List exact properties, never transition-all. Gate entrances behind prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single loud action on any screen: white text on a System Blue gradient with a colored lift glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 24px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 590; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2583FF 14%, #1C5DFF 81.56%); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.12), 0 5px 14px -3px rgba(28,93,255,0.35), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.22); cursor: pointer; transition: scale .2s cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), box-shadow .2s, background-color .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1C5DFF 14%, #1450E0 81.56%); box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.14), 0 10px 22px -4px rgba(28,93,255,0.45), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.28); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1b5bff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { scale: 0.96; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ink text on paper with a hairline border. The quiet counterpart to the primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 24px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 590; color: rgba(0,0,0,0.85); text-decoration: none; background: #fbfbfb; border: 1px solid rgba(237,237,237,0.85); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); cursor: pointer; transition: scale .2s cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), background-color .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(245,245,245,0.85); border-color: rgba(237,237,237,0.6); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1b5bff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { scale: 0.96; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The standard panel surface: subtle fill, one hairline border, 8px corners, no resting shadow.
components.html:
Everything stays on your Mac

No uploads, no account, no servers. Files never leave your machine.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(245,245,245,0.5); border: 1px solid rgba(237,237,237,0.85); border-radius: 8px; padding: 24px; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-card { padding: 32px; } } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: rgba(0,0,0,0.85); } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; letter-spacing: -0.011em; color: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); text-wrap: pretty; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Paper background, hairline border, 8px radius, blue focus ring. No glow.
components.css: .ds-input { min-width: 0; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: -0.011em; color: rgba(0,0,0,0.85); background: #fbfbfb; border: 1px solid rgba(237,237,237,0.85); border-radius: 8px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1b5bff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Body-size link, muted at idle, full ink on hover, System Blue when it is the current page.
components.html: FeaturesPricingBlog
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; gap: 24px; padding: 12px 16px; background: rgba(251,251,251,0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(237,237,237,0.85); } .ds-nav-link { font-size: 16px; text-decoration: none; color: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); border-radius: 8px; transition: color .2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: rgba(0,0,0,0.85); } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #1b5bff; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1b5bff; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Picmal's site looks and behaves like a well-made native Mac utility, not a marketing funnel. System fonts, the macOS action blue, hairline borders, and generous quiet space do the work; the restraint is itself the argument that the app is carefully built. Underneath the native chrome runs a single person's warmth: the voice is first-person from Alberto, a solo developer, plain and honest, and the founder letter renders on elevated paper with a handwritten signature, the one deliberately human note. The system rejects the generic SaaS landing template, the sketchy free-converter look it reacts against, cold enterprise polish, and loud over-animation. Depth comes from hairline borders and a single lifted action, never decorative glass or shadow.
keyCharacteristics: System-native: Apple system font stack, macOS-style blue, no custom brand typeface except the signature.
One accent, used sparingly: blue means action or link, nothing else.
Flat surfaces, hairline borders; a single 8px corner language across the whole site.
Automatic dark mode via light-dark() tokens; every surface designed in both themes at once.
Motion is quiet and physical: press-scale feedback, a one-time staggered hero reveal, prefers-reduced-motion honored.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only hue and appears on a small fraction of any screen: primary CTA, links, active nav, focus. Its rarity is what makes it read as action. Never tint neutrals toward blue, never add a second accent hue. One sanctioned exception: the testimonial key-phrase highlight uses System Blue at ~15% alpha as a text mark, a deliberate low-intensity brand touch and the only non-action use of blue.

rules.name: The Pure Neutral Rule
rules.body: Neutrals are chroma-zero black and white at varying opacity. No warm cream, no cool slate, no tinted paper. Warmth comes from copy and the founder letter, never the background.

rules.name: The Semantic Scale Rule
rules.body: Always use the text-h1 to text-small tokens (or H1-H4 / Paragraph components), never raw text-lg/text-xl. Tune sizes only in the @theme block.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: The system sans is the only UI typeface. The signature script appears exactly once (the founder letter). Never pair a second display or body sans.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow is a response, not decoration: it belongs to the single primary action and to media objects, nowhere else. If a card has a resting drop shadow, it is wrong, use the hairline border.

rules.name: The Image Outline Rule
rules.body: Filled images get a ring-1 ring-black/10 dark:ring-white/10 in pure black/white, never tinted. Transparent cutouts use drop-shadow instead, a ring would box the cutout's bounding rect.

dos: Do use the semantic type tokens and the H1-H4 / Paragraph / Section / Card / SectionHeading primitives. index.astro is the reference implementation.
Do keep neutrals pure black/white at opacity, and let System Blue be the only hue, on a small fraction of any screen.
Do keep every corner at 8px; only rounded-full and explicit app-icon squircles escape.
Do design light and dark at once via light-dark() tokens; verify body text hits 4.5:1 in both themes.
Do give press feedback (active:scale-[0.96]) and a focus-visible accent ring to every interactive element, and gate entrance motion behind prefers-reduced-motion.
Do outline filled images with ring-1 ring-black/10 dark:ring-white/10; use drop-shadow for transparent cutouts.
donts: Don't build the generic SaaS landing template: no gradient-mesh hero, no big-number hero-metric cards, no endless identical icon-card grids.
Don't drift toward the sketchy free-converter look: ad clutter, fake urgency, dark patterns. Picmal is the reaction against it.
Don't go cold-corporate (faceless we-deliver-solutions polish, stock photography) or loud/over-animated (neon, scroll-jacking, constant motion).
Don't put a resting drop shadow on a card; use the hairline border. Depth belongs to the primary button and media frames only.
Don't use gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, side-stripe accent borders over 1px, or a tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow above every section.
Don't tint neutrals toward warm cream or any hue, introduce a second accent color, add a second UI typeface, or use transition-all / em dashes.
